name: pictorem-mcp
display_name: Pictorem PRO (white-label dropship + API Print on Demand) MCP
description: Pictorem PRO (white-label dropship + API Print on Demand) (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products,

platform_mcp_pictorem_artflow_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_PICTOREM_ARTFLOW_KEY
platform_mcp_pictorem_artflow_key.description: Your ArtFlowKey, issued on request through your Pictorem account (can be a test-mode key).

tools.name: me
tools.description: getorderlist with limit 1: verifies the ArtFlowKey and shows the account's order count (data.total).

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: getartworklist: your own Pictorem artworks (name, keywords, categories, orientation, image set). Pictorem sells made-to-order prints: a sellable product is an artwork plus a preordercode (numCopies|material|type|orientation|width|height|options…, see the code builder) priced with getprice. `query`/`category` are not applied.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: sendorder (multipart form). `items`: up to 5 lines in Pictorem form [{code: preordercode, fileurl + filetype (jpg/png/tiff) OR collectionID, bordercolorhex (when the code needs it), comment}]; `shipping_address`: {firstname, lastname, company?, address1, address2?, city, province (state code), country (ISO or name), cp (postal code), phone?, po? (your unique reference; makes retries safe), ordercomment?}. Without a getshippingquote quote the order is created with no shipping charge; `shipping_option` is not applied. Returns the Pictorem orderid.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: getorderstatus by Pictorem order id: order_status (commercial: Processing, Shipped, Canceled…) and production_status (workshop stage, progress %), billing status, tracking, delivery and lines in raw.

tools.name: track
tools.description: getorderstatus: tracking_number/tracking_carrier once shipped (UPS), order and production status; per-line tracking under events (lines).
